summary: Vista Gold Corp. filed an 8-K on September 21, 2026, disclosing a September 20 Arrangement Agreement under which Artemis Gold Inc. will acquire all outstanding Vista common shares via a British Columbia court-approved plan of arrangement. Each share converts into 0.0966 of an Artemis share, a stock-for-stock deal with no cash component. Vista's board, following a Special Committee recommendation, unanimously approved the arrangement, determined it fair and in shareholders' best interests, and recommends shareholder approval. Convertible securities are cashed out or exchanged. The transaction requires a shareholder vote and court approval; the regulatory clock and closing timeline were not detailed. Watch for shareholder dissent, court approval, and any competing bids.
